flavours.name: Fanta Orange
flavours.notes: The flagship flavour. The modern orange recipe was first made in Naples, Italy, in 1955; outside the US it contains orange juice.
flavours.update: Sold worldwide; Zero Sugar version widely available

flavours.name: Fanta Orange (Mexico)
flavours.notes: Mexican-made orange Fanta sweetened with sugar rather than corn syrup, also sold in the US.
flavours.update: Listed on the US Fanta range

flavours.name: Fanta Strawberry
flavours.notes: A strawberry soda, long sold in Algeria and the US, and launched in Canada in 2025.
flavours.update: Zero Sugar version in Indonesia; in Spain only on the Canary Islands

flavours.name: Fanta Grape
flavours.notes: A grape soda, one of the most widely sold Fanta flavours.
flavours.update: Added to the UK core range in February 2026; refreshed in Japan in April 2026; Zero version in South Korea

flavours.name: Fanta Pineapple
flavours.notes: A pineapple soda.
flavours.update: Zero Sugar version in Australia and South Korea; in Spain only on the Canary Islands

flavours.name: Fanta Peach
flavours.notes: A peach soda.
flavours.update: Zero Sugar “refreshing peach” in South Korea

flavours.name: Fanta Piña Colada
flavours.notes: A pineapple and coconut soda (non-alcoholic).
flavours.update: Listed on the US Fanta range

flavours.name: Fanta Berry
flavours.notes: A mixed berry soda.
flavours.update: Listed on the US Fanta range

flavours.name: Fanta Pineapple & Grapefruit
flavours.notes: A pineapple and grapefruit soda that replaced Lilt in the UK and Ireland.
flavours.update: Took over from Lilt in 2024; Zero Sugar in the Netherlands

flavours.name: Fanta Guaraná
flavours.notes: A guaraná soda, one of several regional flavours sold in Brazil.
flavours.update: Brazil regional flavour, sold between 2010 and 2020

flavours.name: Fanta Passion Fruit
flavours.notes: A passion fruit soda sold as a regional flavour in Brazil.
flavours.update: Brazil regional flavour, sold between 2010 and 2020

flavours.name: Fanta Cashew
flavours.notes: A cashew-fruit soda sold as a regional flavour in Brazil.
flavours.update: Brazil regional flavour, sold between 2010 and 2020

flavours.name: Fanta Colita
flavours.notes: A cream-soda style flavour associated with Costa Rica.

flavours.name: Fanta Portello
flavours.notes: A flavour associated with Sri Lanka, where portello is a popular soda style.

flavours.name: Fanta Fruit Twist
flavours.notes: A mixed fruit soda from the UK.
flavours.update: Part of the UK range, with a Zero version

flavours.name: Fanta Exotic
flavours.notes: A tropical mixed fruit soda; Fruit Twist is sold under this name in Scandinavian countries.
flavours.update: Widely sold in Europe, usually with a Zero Sugar version

flavours.name: Fanta Fruit Punch
flavours.notes: A fruit punch soda associated with Thailand; also sold in the Philippines until the 2000s.
flavours.update: Sold in Thailand and Indonesia, and at some stores in Japan

flavours.name: Fanta Lemon
flavours.notes: A lemon soda.
flavours.update: Widely sold in Europe and Australia; often Zero Sugar only

flavours.name: Fanta Shokata
flavours.notes: An elderflower-based soda sold in several European countries, including Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Poland, Romania and Serbia. The name plays on the Romanian word for elderflower.
flavours.update: Lemon and elderflower; Zero version in Poland

flavours.name: Fanta Shokata (Russia)
flavours.notes: A clear, lemonade-like citrus soda sold in a blue bottle in Russia, formerly called Fanta Citrus.

flavours.name: Fanta Calamansi
flavours.notes: A calamansi (Philippine lime) soda introduced in 1994, the only Fanta flavour made just for the Philippines.
flavours.update: Phased out in the 2000s when Fanta was folded into the local Royal brand

flavours.name: Fanta Mango
flavours.notes: A mango soda.
flavours.update: Sold in several European countries; Zero Sugar in Germany

flavours.name: Fanta Green Apple
flavours.notes: A green apple soda sold in the Philippines.
flavours.update: Phased out in the 2000s

flavours.name: Fanta Root Beer
flavours.notes: A root beer sold under the Fanta name in the Philippines.
flavours.update: Phased out in the 2000s

flavours.name: Fanta Z
flavours.notes: A UK Fanta variant advertised in 2005.

flavours.name: Fanta (1940 original)
flavours.notes: The first Fanta, made in Germany from 1940 from whatever ingredients were available, such as whey and apple pomace.
flavours.update: Wartime product, long gone

flavours.name: Fanta Elderberry (Netherlands)
flavours.notes: An elderberry-flavoured Fanta made in the Netherlands during the Second World War.
flavours.update: Wartime product, long gone

flavours.name: Fanta 75th Anniversary Edition
flavours.notes: A glass-bottle edition for Germany with a recipe styled on the original, made with whey and pomace and marketed as less sweet.
flavours.update: Limited 2015 release

flavours.name: Fanta Sweet & Sour Morning Picked White Peach
flavours.notes: A sweet and sour white peach soda made for Japan, an update of the earlier Japan-only peach Fanta.
flavours.update: Summer 2025 release; listed again at some stores in summer 2026

flavours.name: Fanta Yoghurush Mellow Strawberry
flavours.notes: A yoghurt and strawberry soda sold in Japan.

flavours.name: Fanta Crimson Sour Cherry
flavours.notes: A sour cherry soda made with Xbox for its 25th anniversary, themed on Diablo IV.
flavours.update: Limited release from April 2026

flavours.name: Fanta Dark Cherry
flavours.notes: An apple and cherry soda released with an Xbox promotion.
flavours.update: Limited time in the UK

flavours.name: Fanta Ghost Face Punch
flavours.notes: A Halloween punch flavour themed on the Ghost Face character from the Scream films.
flavours.update: Halloween 2026 limited edition

flavours.name: Fanta Raspberry
flavours.notes: A raspberry soda.
flavours.update: Zero Sugar version in Australia, Sweden and Spain

flavours.name: Fanta Blissful Hibiscus
flavours.notes: A hibiscus-flavoured soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Dreamy Cream
flavours.notes: A cream soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Pink Grapefruit Zero Sugar
flavours.notes: A sugar-free pink grapefruit soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Mango Dragonfruit
flavours.notes: A mango and dragon fruit soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Mandarine
flavours.notes: A mandarin soda with no added sugar.

flavours.name: Fanta Lemon & Elderflower
flavours.notes: A lemon and elderflower soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Citron Frappé
flavours.notes: A French lemon soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Cassis
flavours.notes: A blackcurrant soda.
flavours.update: New in France

flavours.name: Fanta Délice Tropical
flavours.notes: A mango, orange and passion fruit soda, formerly sold in France as Fanta Exotique.

flavours.name: Fanta Tutti Frutti
flavours.notes: A peach, pineapple and banana soda.
flavours.update: Zero Sugar; a limited edition in France

flavours.name: Fanta Watermelon
flavours.notes: A watermelon soda with no added sugar.

flavours.name: Fanta Aranciata Rossa
flavours.notes: A blood orange soda made with Sicilian blood orange juice, with no added sugar.

flavours.name: Fanta Limonata
flavours.notes: An Italian lemonade made with lemon juice and pulp.
flavours.update: Also a no-added-sugar version made with Siracusa lemons

flavours.name: Fanta Strawberry Kiwi
flavours.notes: A strawberry and kiwi soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Pomelo
flavours.notes: A grapefruit (pomelo) soda.
flavours.update: Zero Sugar in the Netherlands

flavours.name: Fanta Crimson Cherry
flavours.notes: An apple and cherry soda from the 2026 Xbox promotion, sold in France as Fanta Cerise éclatante.
flavours.update: Limited edition in Europe

flavours.name: Fanta Zero Sugar Forest Berries
flavours.notes: A sugar-free forest berry soda.
flavours.update: Limited edition

flavours.name: Fanta Zero Rød Julebrus
flavours.notes: A sugar-free red forest berry Christmas soda, in the Norwegian julebrus tradition.
flavours.update: Christmas season

flavours.name: Fanta Pomegranate
flavours.notes: A pomegranate soda (Fanta Nar).
flavours.update: New in Turkey

flavours.name: Fanta Melon Soda
flavours.notes: A green melon soda sold in Japan.

flavours.name: Fanta Shikuwasa
flavours.notes: A soda made with shikuwasa, an Okinawan citrus.

flavours.name: Fanta Muscat
flavours.notes: A muscat grape soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Melon
flavours.notes: A melon soda sold in South Korea.

flavours.name: Ambasa by Fanta
flavours.notes: A milky soda sold in South Korea.

flavours.name: Fanta Apple Delite
flavours.notes: An apple soda made for India.

flavours.name: Fanta Apple
flavours.notes: An apple soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Pară Năzdrăvană
flavours.notes: A pear soda with pear juice, made for Romania.

flavours.name: Fanta Tropical
flavours.notes: A tropical fruit soda.

flavours.name: Fanta Madness
flavours.notes: A red grape soda made for Romania.

flavours.name: Fanta Haunted Apple
flavours.notes: A Halloween apple soda released alongside the film Beetlejuice Beetlejuice.
flavours.update: Halloween 2024 limited edition

flavours.name: Fanta Chucky's Punch
flavours.notes: A Halloween fruit punch with a Chucky-themed can.
flavours.update: Halloween 2025 limited edition

flavours.name: Fanta Apple Pie
flavours.notes: The mystery flavour from South Africa's #WhatTheFanta campaign, revealed as apple pie.
flavours.update: Limited edition, revealed February 2024

flavours.name: What The Fanta Blue
flavours.notes: A blue, sugar-free mystery flavour from the What The Fanta campaign in North America.
flavours.update: Limited edition, sold into early 2023
